headline: Knowledge your agents can rely on—not merely recall.
lede: A record earns trust by making writes, corrections, disagreement, and time explicit. Neotoma turns each of those into something agents can query instead of a convention they must remember to follow.

items.label: WRITE
items.title: Facts are committed to a record
items.body: Typed entities and relationships give important state a durable home outside any one prompt, thread, or model context.

items.label: CORRECT
items.title: Corrections replace without erasing
items.body: The current value changes, while its source and superseded value remain available for reconstruction.

items.label: DISAGREE
items.title: Conflicts stay visible
items.body: Competing observations can remain attributable instead of being flattened into whichever sentence was written last.

items.label: REFRESH
items.title: Changing sources can be re-read
items.body: The record distinguishes when something happened from when it was learned, so an agent can reason against the state that was valid at the relevant time.

correction.note: The correction is visible; the prior claim does not silently disappear.

status_note: The page leads with the long-term product ambition. The repository remains the authority for what is shipped today and what is still planned.
